title: Genei wo Kakeru Taiyou: Fumikomenai Kokoro
justification: AniList 20187 (OVA, 1 episode(s) from 2013-11-16) is AniDB 9736's special(s) S1, aired 2013-11-16. AniList's PREQUEL relation names AniList 17651, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 9736, and the special's title (Heart in Doubt / Fumikomenai Kokoro) matches an AniList title. The parent's node, as overlay/9736.json patches it, places S1 on TVDB 0x2 Heart in Doubt, 2013-11-16. TMDB 76899, where the parent's node places the special(s), agrees: S0E1 The Impenetrable Heart 2013-11-16.
